The challenge

The figures already exist. They're just hard to reach.

In Exact Online every answer is ten clicks away, if you know the fastest route. And with the next question, the same cycle of exports, pivot tables and re-typing starts all over. Hiring more people rarely fixes it: the work isn't too much, it's too manual.

Core capabilities

One conversation, the whole administration.

Claire opens up nearly every part of Exact Online, in conversation and autonomously on schedule. Four areas where that pays off immediately.

Reporting & insight

  • Real-time balance sheet, P&L and cash flow, down to the ledger
  • KPI traffic lights: DSO, working capital, runway with alerts
  • Traceable: every answer shows its source data

Financial processes

  • Sales & invoicing: from quote to invoice
  • Purchasing & payables: invoices and open payments
  • Entries: she reviews journals and proposes corrections

Clients & projects

  • CRM: customers, suppliers, opportunities and quotes
  • Projects & hours: budgets, planning, time tracking
  • On screen: interactive tables and cards in the chat

Monitoring & alerts

  • Autonomous on schedule: close checks, weekly overviews
  • Receivables watch: flags overdue items, drafts the reminder
  • Calm: you only hear from her when she needs you

Featured

The AI-driven month-end close.

The close is where control and time pressure collide. Claire is the extra pair of eyes that looks at the same administration every month, running a fixed set of deterministic checks and investigating what stands out.

01 · FIXED

Check

A fixed set of close checks runs on your books.

02 · ANALYSIS

Investigate

Anomalies are investigated and entries scanned for items that need a judgement.

03 · REPORT

Report

You get a close-readiness report with findings and recommendations.

04 · YOU DECIDE

Review

You review each finding; corrections only happen after your approval.

Security & control

A managed product, not loose scripts.

Read freely, write on approval

Claire reads and calculates on her own, but never writes unprompted: every change waits as a proposal for your explicit approval.
